package service

import (
 "context"
 "crypto/sha256"
 "encoding/hex"
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "strings"
 "testing"

 validation "github.com/MalenkiySolovey/solovey-ui/internal/singbox/validation"
 "github.com/sagernet/sing-box/adapter"
 "github.com/sagernet/sing-box/log"
 "github.com/sagernet/sing-box/option"
 "github.com/sagernet/sing-box/route/rule"
)

// Synthetic fixtures are CREATED and accepted only by exact v2026.3.3 code.
// This temporary driver never enters the candidate production worktree.
func TestCaptureNestedRuleBaseline(t *testing.T) {
 out := os.Getenv("SOLOVEY_BASELINE_CAPTURE")
 if out == "" { t.Fatal("capture directory required") }
 if err := os.MkdirAll(out, 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 store := NewSingBoxBaseConfigStore(initSettingTestDB(t))
 shapes := map[string]string{
  "and": `{"type":"logical","mode":"and","action":"reject","rules":[{"domain_suffix":"example","action":"reject"},{"domain":"fixture.example","action":"reject"}]}`,
  "or": `{"type":"logical","mode":"or","action":"reject","rules":[{"domain":"fixture.example","action":"reject"},{"domain":"other.example","action":"reject"}]}`,
  "invert": `{"type":"logical","mode":"or","invert":true,"action":"reject","rules":[{"domain":"fixture.example","invert":true,"action":"reject"},{"type":"logical","mode":"and","action":"reject","rules":[{"domain":"other.example","action":"reject"}]}]}`,
  "conflicting": `{"type":"logical","mode":"or","action":"reject","rules":[{"domain":"fixture.example","action":"reject"},{"domain":"other.example","action":"route"}]}`,
  "action-only": `{"type":"logical","mode":"or","action":"reject","rules":[{"action":"reject"},{"action":"reject"}]}`,
  "implicit-parent": `{"type":"logical","mode":"and","rules":[{"domain":"fixture.example","action":"reject"}]}`,
 }
 deep := `{"domain":"fixture.example","action":"reject"}`
 for i:=1;i<64;i++ { deep=`{"type":"logical","mode":"and","action":"reject","rules":[`+deep+`]}` }
 shapes["depth64"] = deep
 shapes["nodes4096"] = `{"type":"logical","mode":"or","action":"reject","rules":[`+strings.TrimSuffix(strings.Repeat(`{"action":"reject"},`,4095),",")+`]}`
 var manifest []map[string]any
 for _,kind:=range []string{"route","dns"} {
  for _,name:=range []string{"and","or","invert","conflicting","action-only","implicit-parent","depth64","nodes4096"} {
   input:=[]byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"%s":{"rules":[%s]}}`,kind,shapes[name]))
   if _,err:=validation.ValidateRuleConditions(input);err!=nil {t.Fatal(kind,name,err)}
   if err:=store.Set(string(input));err!=nil {t.Fatal(kind,name,err)}
   var opt option.Options
   if err:=opt.UnmarshalJSONContext(context.Background(),input);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
   sourceInput:=input
   persisted,err:=store.Get();if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)};input=[]byte(persisted)
   sourceSum:=sha256.Sum256(sourceInput)
   sum:=sha256.Sum256(input)
   row:=map[string]any{"name":kind+"-"+name,"file":kind+"-"+name+".json","sha256":hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]),"store_accepted":true,"decoder_accepted":true,"source_owner":"service/SingBoxBaseConfigStore.Set; internal/singbox/validation.ValidateRuleConditions","solovey_commit":"3523eeea9f91c091ab3f0fbdb94c3955e37798b4","sing_box":"v1.13.18","creation_command":"SOLOVEY_BASELINE_CAPTURE=<capture-dir> go test -mod=readonly -count=1 -run ^TestCaptureNestedRuleBaseline$ ./service"}
   row["input_sha256"]=hex.EncodeToString(sourceSum[:]);row["state_class"]="PERSISTED_REACHABLE"
   // Truth table of the actual official old match owner plus top-level action.
   if name=="and"||name=="or"||name=="invert"||name=="depth64" {
    var r adapter.Rule
    var err error
    logger:=log.NewNOPFactory().NewLogger("fixture")
    if kind=="route" {r,err=rule.NewRule(context.Background(),logger,opt.Route.Rules[0],true)} else {r,err=rule.NewDNSRule(context.Background(),logger,opt.DNS.Rules[0],true)}
    if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
    matches:=map[string]bool{}
    for _,domain:=range []string{"fixture.example","other.example","neither.example","outside.invalid",""} {m:=adapter.InboundContext{Domain:domain}; matches[domain]=r.Match(&m)}
    row["matches"]=matches; row["action"]=r.Action().Type()
    if c,ok:=r.(interface{Close()error});ok {if err:=c.Close();err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}}
   }
   if err:=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out,row["file"].(string)),input,0600);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
   manifest=append(manifest,row)
  }
 }
 data,err:=json.MarshalIndent(manifest,"","  ");if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out,"manifest.json"),data,0600);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
}
